```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>"
)
```

```{r setup}
library(winpipe)
np_exists("docker_engine")
```

```{r docker-check include=FALSE}
stopifnot(np_exists("docker_engine"))
```


```{r connect}
proxy <- np_proxy("docker_engine")
```


```{r request}
req <- "GET /version HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: localhost\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n"
writeBin(charToRaw(req), con)
```


```{r response}
res <- readBin(con, "raw", 65536)
resp <- httr2::response(url = "docker_engine", body = res)
```
